end.summary:
Manav practised sorting common animals as plant-eaters, meat-eaters, or both; some examples were right, but this was not steady yet.
They practised using teeth and food choices to describe animal diets; this still needs checking next time.
They practised food chains and changes in plant, insect, rodent, and snake numbers; some answers changed during the discussion.
They practised that plants make food using sunlight and water, and connected arrows in a food chain to the eater.
end.parentNote: Asha practised animal diets, teeth, plant food-making, and food chains with Manav. They gave correct examples such as cows and goats as plant-eaters, lions and eagles as meat-eaters, and sparrows eating seeds and insects; the classification was partly right but not steady yet. Manav also corrected the grain prediction later by saying it would decrease when mice increase. At home, ask them to sort five familiar animals into plant-eaters, meat-eaters, or both and give one food example for each.

उम्म... अंधेरे वाला पीला और पतला होगा, कमज़ोर। धूप वाला हरा और मज़बूत दिखेगा। क्योंकि पौधे को धूप चाहिए खाना बनाने के लिए।

Tumne kaha andhere wala paudha peela aur patla hoga, aur dhoop wala hara dikhega. Dhoop paudhe ko khaana banaane mein madad karti hai. Ab khet ki kadi socho: ghaas ko tidda, tidde ko mendhak, aur mendhak ko saanp khaata hai. Agar zyaadatar mendhak gayab ho jaayein, toh tiddon aur saanpon ka kya hoga?
टिड्डे बहुत ज़्यादा हो जाएंगे... और साँप कम हो जाएँगे, शायद भूखे मर जाएँ।

Haan, mendhak kam honge toh tiddon ko khaane wale kam rahenge, isliye tidde badhenge. Saanpon ko mendhak kam milenge, isliye saanp bhi kam ho sakte hain. Ab ek aur khet socho: ullu zyaadatar chale jaayein, toh kuch samay baad bajra badhega ya ghatega?
बाजरा... उम्म... घटेगा।
Tumne kaha bajra ghatega. Chalo kadi mein beech ka kadam bhi dekhein: ullu kam honge, toh chuhon ki ginti ka kya hoga?
उम्म... चूहे... चूहे बहुत ज़्यादा हो जाएंगे? तो चूहे ज़्यादा बाजरा खाएंगे... तो बाजरा... बाजरा बढ़ जाएगा?
Haan, ullu kam honge toh choohe badh sakte hain. Tumne kaha choohe zyaada bajra khaayenge; ab isi se aage socho. Khaaya jaane par khet mein bajra badhega ya ghatega?
घटेगा... क्योंकि चूहे ज़्यादा खा लेंगे।
Haan, choohe zyaada bajra khaayenge, toh bajra ghatega. Ab doosre khet ki baat: agar kisaan saare saanp hata dein, toh chuhon aur anaaj ka kya hoga?
उम्म... चूहे बढ़ जाएँगे, और अनाज कम हो जाएगा... साँप तो किसान के दोस्त हैं।
Tumne kaha saanp na hon toh choohe badhenge aur anaaj ghatega. Isi wajah se saanp kisaan ke kaam aate hain. Ab kadi mein teer lagao: ghaas, tidda, mendhak aur saanp ko kis kram mein rakhoge?
घास को टिड्डा खाता है, फिर मेंढक, फिर साँप... तो घास, टिड्डा, मेंढक, साँप
Tumne khaane ka kram sahi bataya: ghaas, tidda, mendhak, saanp. Ab teeron ki disha bhi bolo. Ghaas aur tidde ke beech teer kis taraf jaayega?
आम का पत्ता → इल्ली... क्योंकि... पत्ते को इल्ली खाती है न, तो खाने की तरफ तीर जाता है।
Haan, aam ka patta illi khaati hai, isliye teer patte se illi ki taraf jaata hai. Ab ghaas ko tidda khaata hai; ghaas aur tidde ke beech teer kis taraf jaayega?
